_comment: Optional per-script settings, keyed by file name in scripts/. Any scripts/*.py not starting with '_' is auto-discovered and run; a script with no entry here is run with no CLI args and reads the env vars CONTRACT_ID, CONTRACT_ORG, INPUT_DIR (parent of <CONTRACT>/*.json), CONTRACT_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR and writes its reports to OUTPUT_DIR (its working directory). Arg placeholders: {contract} {org} {input_dir} {contract_dir} {output_dir} {cache_dir}. 'attach' = report globs to attach to this script's email, in priority order, up to the size budget.
